title: Theater
description: An operational theater: a flat map or a planet, with location markers

type.description: Rendering type: flat 2D map or planet sphere

active.description: Whether the theater is visible to players (inactive theaters are hidden from clients)

backgroundImage.description: Filename of the flat background map (served via /theater-assets)

textureImage.description: Filename of the planet surface texture (served via /planet-textures, Iteration 2)

notes: Flat theaters use normalized x/y (0..1) for resolution-independent markers.
Planet theaters use lat/lon on location markers (Iteration 2).
Locations may reference a childTheaterId to enable drill-down sublocations.
Assigned jobs are stored as references (job IDs) into jobs.json; job data itself is never duplicated.
